author: Claude (independent verification track)
scope: Q2 / Area-A. No search, no frontier re-run, no bounded completion search. Corpus statistics are used only to measure payoff, never to derive the theorem.

e1_structure.definition: E^1 = macro edge (ell=5, w2:10), joint_kind Z2; the unique generator free in Phi, Ndef, O and F (Round 76)
e1_structure.legality: legal exactly when the current hexagon holds only the endpoint p; agreement pc(hex(p))==1 <-> ell_max==5 on 4000/4000 residual states
e1_structure.closure_is_bounded: E^1 advances the phase within q0 by +1 on a 5-cycle, so the E^1-closure of any state has at most 5 elements; observed chain lengths 0..4, never more
e1_structure.conclusion: E^1 is not an unbounded free escape: it is capped at 4 uses per orbit visit and each use consumes a fresh hexagon

geometry.status: EC (exhaustive computation over all 144 orbits and 120 hexagons)

theorem.name: ORBIT-HEXAGON COVER
derivation: area_a_final requires visited_count == 720, so every one of the 120 hexagons ends full
a hexagon is entered only by a joint landing in it (rotations never leave the current hexagon)
every joint has weight >= 2 and therefore registers its target's (orbit, phase); the initial window is registered too
hence every hexagon contains at least one registered port, so c(h) >= 1 for all 120 hexagons
each of the 25 final open orbits has 5 ports in 5 distinct hexagons, so sum_h c(h) = 125
orbit masks are only ever set, never cleared, so c_open(h) <= c_final(h) pointwise and the bound holds at every earlier state
theorem.side: demand-side (which orbits must end up open); indifferent to entry multiplicity, q0 return and repeated re-entry
theorem.status: HP (hand-proof) with EC-verified geometry and engine premises

adversarial_checks.identity_5O_minus_covered: 0 violations over 13,336 macro steps of 400 random legal walks
adversarial_checks.feasibility: a 25-orbit set covering all 120 hexagons with excess exactly 5 exists (greedy witness); 24 orbits give a perfect cover -- the bound is restrictive, not vacuous
adversarial_checks.e1_closure_test: run BEFORE payoff measurement: incidence_collisions and covered_hexagons are literally invariant across every E^1 step

notes.sharp_form_added_nothing: the sharpened cover capacity (top 25-O closed orbits by uncovered-hexagon contribution) closed 0 further states: on every survivor the top orbits each still reach 5 uncovered hexagons
notes.prior_art: the per-orbit observation 'a fresh segment covers at most 5 hexagons, one per port' is already in src/verify_rr_target_b_flow.py (Round-32 capacity, supply direction). What is new here is the GLOBAL consequence for the final open set, which no committed bound levies.
